description: This file defines a PHP class or script that manages the display of invitees (contacts and users) for a call within a subpanel view in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It sets up a form for selecting contacts and users, and renders lists of invitees using a templating system.
external_methods: global variables included in the script

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: A template engine used for rendering HTML templates with assigned variables.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a section within the template.
